	else

	end

	if jumpscare and jumpscare.Parent then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end
end)

--// PP EFEKTİ
local ppButton = createButton("PP")

local ppEffect = nil
local ppConnection = nil
local ppRunning = false

local function stopPP()
	ppRunning = false

	if ppConnection then
		ppConnection:Disconnect()
		ppConnection = nil
	end

	if ppEffect then
		ppEffect:Destroy()
		ppEffect = nil
	end
end

ppButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	-- Açıkken tekrar basılırsa kapat
	if ppRunning then
		stopPP()
		return
	end

	ppRunning = true

	ppEffect = Instance.new("Frame")
	ppEffect.Name = "SCPP"
	ppEffect.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ppEffect.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	ppEffect.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ppEffect.ZIndex = 90
	ppEffect.Parent = gui

	--// BÜYÜK FOTOĞRAF
	local bigPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	bigPhoto.Name = "SunPhoto"
	bigPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 170)

	bigPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bigPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 0)

	bigPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bigPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	bigPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	bigPhoto.ZIndex = 92
	bigPhoto.Parent = ppEffect

	local bigCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bigCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bigCorner.Parent = bigPhoto

	--// FOTOĞRAFIN ETRAFINDAKİ ÇİZGİ
	local orbit = Instance.new("Frame")
	orbit.Name = "Orbit"
	orbit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 250)

	orbit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	orbit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)

	orbit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	orbit.ZIndex = 91
	orbit.Parent = ppEffect

	local orbitCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	orbitCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	orbitCorner.Parent = orbit

	local orbitStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	orbitStroke.Thickness = 3
	orbitStroke.Transparency = 0.15
	orbitStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	orbitStroke.Parent = orbit

	--// KÜÇÜK DÜNYA
	local smallPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	smallPhoto.Name = "OrbitPhoto"
	smallPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)

	smallPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	smallPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	smallPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	smallPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	smallPhoto.ZIndex = 95
	smallPhoto.Parent = orbit

	local smallCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	smallCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	smallCorner.Parent = smallPhoto

	--// SOL ALT TARAFA HAREKET
	local moveTween = TweenService:Create(
		bigPhoto,
		TweenInfo.new(
			3,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
			Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
		),
		{
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)
		}
	)

	moveTween:Play()

	moveTween.Completed:Wait()

	if not ppRunning then
		return
	end

	--// YÖRÜNGE DÖNÜŞÜ
	local angle = 0

	ppConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)

		if not ppRunning then
			return
		end

		angle = angle + (deltaTime * 100)

		local radians = math.rad(angle)

		local radius = 125

		local x = math.cos(radians) * radius
		local y = math.sin(radians) * radius

		smallPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(
			0.5,
			x,
			0.5,
			y
		)
	end)
end)

--// CLEAR ALL

	-- Particle
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local char = plr.Character
		local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then

			local particle = head:FindFirstChild("SCPhotoParticle")

			if particle then
				particle:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	-- Decal
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do

				if child:IsA("Decal")
					and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 8) == "SCPhoto_" then

					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

	-- Skybox
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SCTeamSky")

	if sky then
		sky:Destroy()
	end

	-- Jumpscare
	local jumpscare = gui:FindFirstChild("SCJumpscare")

	if jumpscare then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end

	-- PP
	stopPP()
end)

--// SÜRÜKLEME
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos
local dragInput

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end

		end)
	end
end)

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input == dragInput and dragging then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--// KÜÇÜLT / AÇ
local minimized = false
local savedSize = frame.Size

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if not minimized then

		minimized = true

		savedSize = frame.Size
		holder.Visible = false

		frame.Size = UDim2.new(
			savedSize.X.Scale,
			savedSize.X.Offset,
			0,
			48
		)

		toggle.Text = "+"

	else

		minimized = false

		frame.Size = savedSize
		holder.Visible = true

		toggle.Text = "−"
	end
end)

--[[
    KHENZ // Billboard 500K Loop — Anti-Lag Edition
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.ANTI_PURCHASE = false
_G.FPS_GUARD = true
_G.AUTO_UNSPAM = true

local THEME = {
    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    bg_card = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32),
    bg_input= Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 44),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 180),
    purple  = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 255),
    danger  = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 90),
    gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    warn    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60),
    text    = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245),
}

-- FIX 500K (TURUN DARI 1M) + RADIUS AUTO
local FIXED_LOOP = 500000
local FIXED_BATCH = 2500
local CLICK_RADIUS = 5000

local State = {
    spamEnabled = false,
    loopCount = FIXED_LOOP,
    batchSize = FIXED_BATCH,
    successCount = 0,
    blockedCount = 0,
    detectors = {},
    fps = 60,
    fpsHistory = {},
    normalFpsCounter = 0,
    unspamActive = false,
}

local function log(msg)
    print("[KHENZ] " .. msg)
end

-- ============ FPS TRACKER ============
local frameCount = 0
local lastFpsUpdate = tick()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frameCount = frameCount + 1
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastFpsUpdate >= 0.5 then
        local elapsed = now - lastFpsUpdate
        local currentFPS = math.floor(frameCount / elapsed)
        State.fps = currentFPS
        table.insert(State.fpsHistory, currentFPS)
        if #State.fpsHistory > 6 then table.remove(State.fpsHistory, 1) end
        frameCount = 0
        lastFpsUpdate = now
    end
end)

local function avgFPS()
    if #State.fpsHistory == 0 then return State.fps end
    local sum = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(State.fpsHistory) do sum = sum + v end
    return math.floor(sum / #State.fpsHistory)
end

-- ============ AUTO UNSPAM ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        if _G.AUTO_UNSPAM and State.spamEnabled then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            if fps > 50 then
                State.normalFpsCounter = State.normalFpsCounter + 1
                if State.normalFpsCounter >= 5 then
                    State.unspamActive = true
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: 5s")
                    task.wait(5)
                    State.unspamActive = false
                    State.normalFpsCounter = 0
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: done")
                end
            else
                State.normalFpsCounter = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ AUTO-SCAN BILLBOARD ============
local function detectBillboardDetectors()
    local detectors = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name:lower():find("billboard") then
            local board = obj:FindFirstChild("Board")
            if board then
                local cd = board:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
                if cd and cd:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, cd)
                end
            end
            for _, v in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #detectors == 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ClickDetector") and v.Parent then
                local p = v.Parent
                local gp = p.Parent
                if p.Name:lower():find("board")
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("board"))
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("billboard")) then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return detectors
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        State.detectors = detectBillboardDetectors()
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)

-- ============ SPAM LOOP — 500K ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if State.spamEnabled and #State.detectors > 0 and not State.unspamActive then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            local curLoop = FIXED_LOOP
            local curBatch = FIXED_BATCH

            if _G.FPS_GUARD then
                if fps < 15 then
                    task.wait(1)
                    local waitCount = 0
                    while avgFPS() < 20 and waitCount < 10 do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        waitCount = waitCount + 1
                    end
                elseif fps < 30 then
                    curLoop = 50000
                    curBatch = 250
                elseif fps < 50 then
                    curLoop = 250000
                    curBatch = 1000
                end
            end

            local batch = 0
            for i = 1, curLoop do
                if not State.spamEnabled or State.unspamActive then break end
                if i % 1000 == 0 and _G.FPS_GUARD and avgFPS() < 15 then break end

                for _, cd in ipairs(State.detectors) do
                    pcall(function()
                        fireclickdetector(cd, CLICK_RADIUS, 1)
                    end)
                    State.successCount = State.successCount + 1
                    batch = batch + 1
                end

                if batch >= curBatch then
                    batch = 0
                    task.wait()
                end
            end

            task.wait()
        else
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ ANTI PURCHASE ============
local function disablePrompt()
    pcall(function()
        local prompt = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("PurchasePromptApp")
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
            prompt.Enabled = false
            State.blockedCount = State.blockedCount + 1
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local overlay = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("FoundationOverlay")
        if overlay and overlay.Enabled then
            overlay.Enabled = false
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE then disablePrompt() end
end)

CoreGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ins)
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE and (ins.Name == "PurchasePromptApp" or ins.Name == "FoundationOverlay") then
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function() ins.Enabled = false end)
    end
end)

CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(ins)
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE and (ins.Name == "PurchasePromptApp" or ins.Name == "FoundationOverlay") then
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function() ins.Enabled = false end)
    end
end)

-- ============ GUI ============
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("KHENZ_Billboard") then CoreGui.KHENZ_Billboard:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "KHENZ_Billboard"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
pcall(function() gui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 280)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -140)
main.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.bg
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = THEME.danger
stroke.Transparency = 0.5
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Parent = main

local topbar = Instance.new("Frame")
topbar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
topbar.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.bg_card
topbar.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- BACKROOMS INFINITE MAZE LOADER SCRIPT (V4 - REAL FALL GRAVITY)
-- Sistem pembersihan ultra pantas, pemadaman Baseplate, dan jatuhan graviti rawak supaya pemain tidak bertindih di atas kepala.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- KONFIGURASI BACKROOMS
local CHUNK_SIZE = 40 
local WALL_HEIGHT = 12
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local RENDER_DISTANCE = 3 

local generatedChunks = {} 
local backroomsFolder

-- 1. PEMBERSIHAN MAP LAMA & BASEPLATE
local function clearMap()
    debug.profilebegin("FastMapClear")
    local children = workspace:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local obj = children[i]
        if not obj:IsA("Camera") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    debug.profileend()
    print("✓ Map lama dan Baseplate dipadamkan!")
end

-- Fungsi Matematik Deterministik Maze
local function getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, wallType)
    local seed = math.sin(chunkX * 12.9898 + chunkZ * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    local pseudoRandom = seed - math.floor(seed)
    if wallType == "North" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "West" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "CenterH" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    if wallType == "CenterV" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    return false
end

-- 2. PENJANAAN CHUNK
local function generateChunk(chunkX, chunkZ)
    local chunkKey = chunkX .. "," .. chunkZ
    if generatedChunks[chunkKey] then return end 
    generatedChunks[chunkKey] = true

    local chunkModel = Instance.new("Model")
    chunkModel.Name = "Chunk_" .. chunkKey
    chunkModel.Parent = backroomsFolder

    local worldX = chunkX * CHUNK_SIZE
    local worldZ = chunkZ * CHUNK_SIZE

    -- Lantai Karpet Kuning Lembap
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, -0.5, worldZ)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 170, 115) 
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Siling Beton
    local ceiling = Instance.new("Part")
    ceiling.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    ceiling.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, worldZ)
    ceiling.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 180)
    ceiling.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    ceiling.Anchored = true
    ceiling.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Fungsi Dinding
    local function createWall(size, position)
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = size
        wall.Position = position
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 130) 
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Parent = chunkModel
    end

    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "North") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ - CHUNK_SIZE/2))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "West") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterH") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/4, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterV") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE/2), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ + CHUNK_SIZE/4))
    end

    -- Lampu Neon
    local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
    lightPart.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 2)
    lightPart.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, worldZ)
    lightPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
    lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    lightPart.Anchored = true
    lightPart.Parent = chunkModel

    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Brightness = 2
    pointLight.Range = 30
    pointLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200)
    pointLight.Parent = lightPart

    if math.random() > 0.7 then
        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(math.random(3, 10)) do
                if not lightPart or not lightPart.Parent then break end
                pointLight.Enabled = false
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                task.wait(math.random(0.1, 0.4))
                pointLight.Enabled = true
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- 3. LOAD MAP BACKROOM UTAMA
local function createBackroomsMap()
    backroomsFolder = Instance.new("Model")
    backroomsFolder.Name = "Backrooms_Infinite"
    backroomsFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local spawnPart = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
    spawnPart.Name = "MainSpawn"
    spawnPart.Size = Vector3.new(15, 1, 15)
    spawnPart.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
    spawnPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 100)
    spawnPart.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    spawnPart.Anchored = true
    spawnPart.CanCollide = true
    spawnPart.Parent = backroomsFolder

    for x = -2, 2 do
        for z = -2, 2 do
            generateChunk(x, z)
        end
    end
    
    Lighting.Brightness = 0.8
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 60)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    
    local ambientSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    ambientSound.Name = "FluorescentHum"
    ambientSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9069509268" 
    ambientSound.Volume = 0.4
    ambientSound.Looped = true
    ambientSound.Parent = workspace
    ambientSound:Play()
    
    print("✓ Backrooms Map Yuklendi!")
end

-- 4. TELEPORTASI DAN JATUH DENGAN GRAVITI REALISTIK (Anti-Bertindih)
local function teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    
    if rootPart and humanoid then
        -- MENGALIS RENTIK: Membuat kedudukan X dan Z rawak (jejari 4 stud) di kawasan spawn
        -- Ketinggian (Y = 10.5) ditetapkan ngam di bawah siling supaya mereka jatuh bebas secara realistik
        local offsetX = math.random(-4, 4)
        local offsetZ = math.random(-4, 4)
        local targetPosition = Vector3.new(offsetX, 10.5, offsetZ)
        
        -- Pindahkan watak dengan PivotTo ke udara
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPosition))
        
        -- Memaksa fizik Roblox mengemas kini jatuhan momentum dengan serta-merta
        task.defer(function()
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0) -- Momentum awal jatuhan laju ke bawah karpet
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Teleport untuk semua pemain sedia ada
local function respawnPlayers()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            teleportPlayerWithGravity(player.Character)
        end
    end
end

-- 5. RESPON KEMATIAN DENGAN GRAVITI RAWAK
local function setupDeathRespawn()
    local function onCharacterAdded(character)
        task.wait(0.1) -- Tunggu watak dimuatkan sepenuhnya oleh enjin game
        teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    end

    local function onPlayerAdded(player)
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end
end

-- 6. SISTEM AUTO-GENERATE PANTAS (Semasa Berjalan)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do 
        local playersList = Players:GetPlayers()
        for i = 1, #playersList do
            local player = playersList[i]
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local currentChunkX = math.floor((hrp.Position.X + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)
                local currentChunkZ = math.floor((hrp.Position.Z + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)

                for x = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                    for z = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                        generateChunk(currentChunkX + x, currentChunkZ + z)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- EKSEKUSI UTAMA
print("==========================================")
-- Memulakan sistem muat turun Backrooms
print("==========================================")

clearMap()            
createBackroomsMap()  
respawnPlayers()      
setupDeathRespawn()

print("SISTEM REAL GRAVITY JATUH AKTIF!")

local itemESP=false
local itemObjects={}

local function clearItems()
    for _,x in ipairs(itemObjects) do
        if x then x:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(itemObjects)
end

local function isRealItem(o)
    if not (o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return false
    end

    local n=o.Name:lower()

    return n=="pole" or n=="screwdriver"
end

local function updateItems()
    clearItems()
    if not itemESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRealItem(o) then
            local p=getPart(o)

            if p then
                local duplicate=false

                for _,d in ipairs(detected) do
                    if o:IsDescendantOf(d) or d:IsDescendantOf(o) then
                        duplicate=true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not duplicate then
                    table.insert(detected,o)

                    local name=o.Name:lower()=="pole"
                        and "POLE"
                        or "SCREWDRIVER"

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=o
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,120)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.45
                    table.insert(itemObjects,h)

                    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                    bb.Adornee=p
                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,35)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2000
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(itemObjects,bb)

                    local text=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    text.Text=name
                    text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)

                    text.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                    text.TextSize=15
                    text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

    end
end

local verESP=false
local verObjects={}

local function clearVER()
    for _,v in ipairs(verObjects) do
        if v then v:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(verObjects)
end

local function updateVER()
    clearVER()
    if not verESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then

            local n=obj.Name:lower()
            local isVER=(n=="ver")
            local isMonster=n=="monster" or n:match("^monster[%w_%.%-]*$")~=nil

            local hum=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local moving=false

            if hum and root then
                moving=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>2
            end

            if isVER or (isMonster and moving) then
                local part=getPart(obj)

                if part and not detected[obj] then
                    detected[obj]=true

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=obj
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,40,40)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.35
                    table.insert(verObjects,h)

                    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                    bb.Adornee=part
                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(180,38)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2500
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(verObjects,bb)

                    local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    txt.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    txt.Text=isVER and "VER" or "MOVING MONSTER"
                    txt.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
                    txt.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                    txt.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                    txt.TextSize=16
                    txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"ESP VER (Monocroma)",function(on)
    verESP=on
    updateVER()
end)

local dragging=false

head.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)

    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        startPos=main.Position
    end

U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if dragging and (
        i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local d=i.Position-dragStart

        main.Position=UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset+d.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y
        )
    end
end)

U.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging=false
    end
end)
